1.title: Microsoft Entra ID, Identities and Hybrid Identity
1.text: Welcome to Module three: Microsoft Entra I D, Identities and Hybrid Identity. It covers the exam area Capabilities of Microsoft Entra. Each part of this module comes from the study notes of the same name, so you can read the notes after you watch.

1.title: What You Will Learn
1.text: By the end of this module you will be able to do four things. Describe Microsoft Entra I D. Describe types of identities, including workload identities. Describe hybrid identity. Practice with exam-style questions and a recall check.

1.title: Where This Fits in the Exam
1.text: Here is where this module sits in the exam. Exam area: Capabilities of Microsoft Entra (twenty-five to thirty percent). Exam format: forty-five minutes; a score of seven hundred on a scale of one to one thousand passes. Validated against: the official S C nine hundred study guide, skills measured as of October twenty-one, two thousand twenty-six.

1.title: Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Entra ID
1.text: Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Entra I D. Microsoft Entra is the family of Microsoft identity and network access products. Microsoft Entra I D is the cloud-based identity and access management service: it stores identities and signs people in to Azure, Microsoft three sixty-five and thousands of other apps. It was called Azure Active Directory (Azure A D).

1.title: Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Entra ID, continued
1.text: Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Entra I D. Tenant. A dedicated instance of Microsoft Entra I D for an organization. Users, groups, devices, apps. The objects stored in the tenant. Single sign-on. Sign in once, reach many apps. Licenses. Free (core features), P one and P two (more features), plus Microsoft Entra I D Governance. Entra I D provides authentication (sign-in, M F A), access management (Conditional Access, roles) and identity protection and governance (modules four to six).

1.title: Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Entra ID, continued
1.text: Microsoft Entra and Microsoft Entra I D. The figure shows this: The Microsoft Entra product family around Microsoft Entra I D. Exam tip: Entra I D equals the cloud identity service (formerly Azure A D). It is not a cloud version of Windows domain controllers; that is a different service (Microsoft Entra Domain Services). Microsoft Entra is the name of the whole family.

1.title: Types of identities
1.text: Types of identities. User (member). What it is: A person inside the organization. Examples: An employee. External user (guest). What it is: A person outside the organization invited to collaborate. Examples: A partner, a contractor. Group. What it is: A set of users managed together. Examples: A security group. Device identity. What it is: A computer or phone registered or joined to Entra. Examples: A laptop. Workload identity. What it is: An identity for software, not a person. Examples: An app, a script, a service.

1.title: Workload identities
1.text: Workload identities. A workload identity lets an application, service or script authenticate and access resources without a person. Application (app registration). The definition of an app in Entra I D. Service principal. The identity of the app in a tenant; used to get access. Managed identity. An identity managed automatically by Azure for an Azure resource: no credentials to store or rotate. Managed identity types: system-assigned (tied to one resource, deleted with it) and user-assigned (a separate resource that can be shared by several).

1.title: Device identities
1.text: Device identities. Microsoft Entra registered. Personal or B Y O D device registered. Microsoft Entra joined. Organization-owned device joined to the cloud. Microsoft Entra hybrid joined. Device joined to both on-premises A D and Entra I D.

1.title: Device identities, continued
1.text: Device identities. The figure shows this: Identity types in Microsoft Entra: users, guests, groups, devices and workload identities. Exam tip: A workload identity belongs to software. A managed identity is the best choice for an Azure resource that needs access, because it needs no secrets. System-assigned equals lifecycle tied to the resource; user-assigned equals reusable.

1.title: Hybrid identity
1.text: Hybrid identity. Hybrid identity means one identity that works for both on-premises and cloud resources. Organizations that already use Active Directory Domain Services (A D D S) synchronize their identities to Microsoft Entra I D. Microsoft Entra Connect. Synchronizes on-premises A D D S identities to Entra I D. Microsoft Entra Cloud Sync. A lightweight, cloud-managed agent for sync.

1.title: Sign-in methods for hybrid identity
1.text: Sign-in methods for hybrid identity. Password hash synchronization. A hash of the password hash is synced to Entra I D; the cloud validates sign-in. Pass-through authentication. Entra I D passes the sign-in to an on-premises agent that checks A D D S. Federation (for example A D F S). Sign-in is redirected to an on-premises federation service. Users get one set of credentials and S S O across cloud and on-premises apps.

1.title: Sign-in methods for hybrid identity, continued
1.text: Sign-in methods for hybrid identity. The figure shows this: Hybrid identity: on-premises Active Directory synchronized to Microsoft Entra I D. Exam tip: Hybrid identity equals on-premises A D synchronized to Entra I D. The tool is Entra Connect (or Cloud Sync). Password hash sync is the simplest; pass-through keeps checks on-premises; federation uses a separate federation service.

1.title: Practice Question 1
1.text: Question one. Fabrikam Outdoors wants an Azure web app to read a storage account without storing a password in code. Which identity is the best choice? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: A managed identity. A managed identity gives an Azure resource an identity with no credentials to manage.

1.title: Practice Question 2
1.text: Question two. A contractor from another company needs access to one Fabrikam app. Which identity type represents the contractor? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: External user (guest). A person outside the organization invited to collaborate is an external (guest) user.

1.title: Practice Question 3
1.text: Question three. Which tool synchronizes on-premises Active Directory identities to Microsoft Entra I D? The four options are on the screen. The answer is A: Microsoft Entra Connect. Microsoft Entra Connect (or Cloud Sync) provides the synchronization for hybrid identity.

1.title: Practice Question 4
1.text: Question four. A managed identity is tied to one virtual machine and is deleted when the V M is deleted. Which type is it? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: System-assigned. A system-assigned managed identity shares the lifecycle of its resource.

1.title: Practice Question 5
1.text: Question five. Microsoft Entra I D was previously known by which name? The four options are on the screen. The answer is C: Azure Active Directory. Azure Active Directory was renamed Microsoft Entra I D.

1.title: Practice Question 6
1.text: Question six. An organization wants sign-in to be checked by an on-premises agent that queries Active Directory. Which method fits? The four options are on the screen. The answer is B: Pass-through authentication. Pass-through authentication validates sign-in against on-premises A D D S through an agent.

1.title: Recall Check 1
1.text: Recall check one. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question one. What was Microsoft Entra I D called before? Answer: Azure Active Directory (Azure A D). Question two. What is a workload identity? Answer: An identity for software, such as an app, service or script. Question three. Name the two managed identity types. Answer: System-assigned and user-assigned.

1.title: Recall Check 2
1.text: Recall check two. Say each answer out loud before you listen to mine. Question four. What does hybrid identity mean? Answer: One identity that works for both on-premises and cloud resources. Question five. Which tool synchronizes A D D S to Entra I D? Answer: Microsoft Entra Connect (or Entra Cloud Sync). Question six. Name the three device identity states. Answer: Registered, joined and hybrid joined.

1.title: Module Recap
1.text: Here is the recap. Entra I D: cloud identity and access management (formerly Azure A D); tenant; Free, P one, P two, I D Governance. Identity types: users (members), external guests, groups, device identities, workload identities. Workload identities: app registration, service principal, managed identity (system-assigned or user-assigned; no secrets). Hybrid identity: Entra Connect or Cloud Sync; password hash sync, pass-through authentication, federation (A D F S). In the next module, we continue the course.
